messages.content: Hi, this is your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Did you log your glucose reading this week?
Yeah, got it on Wed. 156 in the morning.
Logged it. That's higher than usual for you - stress or anything new going on?
Work's been hectic. Also been having some chest tightness. Should I worry?
Chest tightness is something I need to escalate to our nurse for - can't advise on that myself. Median wait is about 31 hours right now. Want me to escalate?
Nah, it's only been occasional. Probably just stress.
Okay, got it. Next check-in is Wednesday. If the tightness comes back or gets worse, let us know and we'll escalate immediately.

theme: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else
